note: Canoe and kayak outfitter's campground in Milltown on the Blue River. RV sites are grass, along and inside a gravel loop road; the row on the riverbank is tent-only. --Claude
summary: Confirmed $38-50 and water, added 50A, 31 sites (19 fit 23 ft), 43-ft max, pull-through, showers, dump, FareHarbor booking, 7-night max. RV camping is a real offer. Not waterfront: lead to riverview. Season not stated.
flags: GATE: base $38 (camper/tent electric only), pull-through water+electric $50 on the operator's own page, labelled 'Starting Camping Pricing'. FareHarbor's calendar showed no bookable dates for Nov 2026, May 2027 or July 2027, so I could not read whether a weekend costs more than the 'starting' figure. Google 4.7 from 1,826 reviews, but the listing is the canoe outfitter, not only the campground; reviews not opened. No gateway within 40 km (Louisville 46 km). No Good Sam/Passport/military statement. No long-stay character: 1-7 nights only.

WATER LEAD (stored not waterfront -> riverview): operator: 'all grassy campsites provide a beautiful river view'; the FAQ ties the view to the primitive sites ('primitive/non electric sites with a river view'). Operator's map puts tent-only sites 14-23 on the bank, then the outer loop road, then pull-through 24-31 in the infield, then the inner road, then electric 1-13 on the far side. So every RV site has a loop road and a tent row or infield between it and the river, which blocks on-water. Imagery (pin ~25 m from the site centre, no move): infield RV sites sit roughly 50-90 m from the bank; the drone photo on the operator's page shows the river through trees from the infield. That reads as riverview for 24-31 at least. Channel about 30-40 m wide at the campground on imagery (estimate; Overpass timed out), so river rather than creek.
PHOTO: operator's drone photo shows tents and cars only, and the map's camper icons are drawings. No photo of a motorhome on a site read.
